text: dsh-pro-vision-std 是面向 DSH Web 和 TUI 的 dsh-std Community v0.15 模型提供者，为 DeepSeek V4-Pro 增加图像输入能力。它先用 Flash Vision 将附件图片转换为带标签的文字说明，再把文本请求交给 V4-Pro 流式生成回答；同时提供 describe_image 工具，可描述工作区图片或最近附加的图片，并缓存相同图像的说明。适合需要让纯文本模型理解截图、照片或图表的 DSH 用户。需要 DeepSeek API key，可复用 DSH 中的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，也可设置插件专用覆盖值。

dsh-pro-vision-std adds image input to DeepSeek V4-Pro in DSH. Flash Vision captions attachments before V4-Pro streams a text response. Its describe_image tool describes a workspace image or latest attachment. Requires a DeepSeek API key, reusable from DSH.
想让 DSH 里的 DeepSeek V4-Pro 看懂我发的截图。
能不能把工作区的一张图片描述成文字给模型使用？
I want my DSH model to interpret image attachments and answer with their contents.
dsh-pro-vision-std 的功能「图片输入模型路由」：模型收到图像附件时，先调用 Flash Vision 生成带图像标签的文字说明，再将替换后的文本消息交给 V4-Pro 流式回答。
dsh-pro-vision-std 的功能「显式图片描述」：调用 describe_image 工具并传入工作区相对路径或使用最近附加图片，可选择附加提示词，工具返回图片说明文本。
dsh-pro-vision-std 使用 DeepSeek API：图片会发送给 Flash Vision 生成说明，替换后的文本请求再发送给 V4-Pro；需要可用的 DeepSeek API key。

dsh-pro-vision-std README · dsh-pro-vision-std：[中文](README.zh.md) · English

**Compatible with dsh-std Community v0.15.**

A portable `ModelProvider` that lets DeepSeek V4-Pro handle image attachments. Images are first captioned by `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`; the resulting text is then sent to `deepseek-v4-pro`. The host facet uses dsh-std contracts and does not import `@deepseek-ai/*`.

dsh-pro-vision-std README · Compatibility：| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Standard | [dsh-std](https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-std) Community v0.15 |
| `$schema` | `urn:dsh-std:community-draft:dsh-plugin:0.15` |
| Component id | `io.github.lasdrder0705.dsh-pro-vision-std` |
| Host entry | `lib/host.js` |
| DSH host | [`@dsh-std/adapter-dsh`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dsh-std/adapter-dsh) |
| Node.js | `22.19+` or `24+` |
| CI | Windows, macOS, and Linux |

dsh-pro-vision-std README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-std/adapter-dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lasdrder0705/dsh-pro-vision-std
```

To update an existing installation:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-pro-vision-std
```

Restart the DSH profile after installation or update.

dsh-pro-vision-std README · Select the image-capable route：In the model selector, choose:

```text
dsh-pro-vision / deepseek-v4-pro
```

This exact route advertises `text + image`. The previous model id, `dsh-pro-vision / deepseek-v4-pro-vision`, remains available as a compatibility alias.

dsh-pro-vision-std README · Select the image-capable route：The official route `deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-pro` remains text-only. dsh-std isolates providers by route, so installing this component does not alter or impersonate the official provider. If DSH reports that V4-Pro cannot accept images, verify that the selected provider is `dsh-pro-vision`.

dsh-pro-vision-std README · API key reuse：On DeepSeek Harness, the component automatically reuses the existing `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` resolved by the DSH credential service, including a key already saved from the Models page. Users do not need to enter the same key again.

dsh-pro-vision-std README · API key reuse：`DSH_PRO_VISION_API_KEY` is an optional per-plugin environment override. Outside DSH, the portable facet falls back to `DSH_PRO_VISION_API_KEY` and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` from the launch environment. Credential values are resolved for each operation, are not written to plugin configuration, and are not logged.

Optional environment settings:

dsh-pro-vision-std README · API key reuse：```text
DSH_PRO_VISION_BASE_URL              default https://api.deepseek.com
DSH_PRO_VISION_VISION_MODEL          default deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp
DSH_PRO_VISION_TEXT_MODEL            default deepseek-v4-pro
DSH_PRO_VISION_MAX_VISION_TOKENS     default 8192

dsh-pro-vision-std README · Behavior：1. The provider reads image attachments through the dsh-std `readImage` contract.
2. Flash Vision creates a precise caption for each image.
3. Each image block becomes an `[Image N] ...` text note.
4. V4-Pro streams the final response from the rewritten text-only request.
5. Identical image bytes are cached in process.

The package also publishes the dsh-std Tool `describe_image` for describing one workspace or recently attached image explicitly.

dsh-pro-vision-std README · Relationship to the original plugin：This repository is the dsh-std rewrite of [dsh-pro-vision](https://github.com/lasdrder0705/dsh-pro-vision). The original plugin intercepts a DSH-specific Cordis `llm/stream`; this package instead publishes an isolated, portable ModelProvider. They are separate packages and may coexist.

npm run check
npm pack --dry-run
```
